primary.title: Post Office vs FD vs Arbitrage Fund: Which one offers best post-tax returns? Compare risk and liquidity before investing
primary.summary: Post office deposits, bank FDs and arbitrage funds differ in post-tax returns, liquidity and risk. A ₹5 lakh investment could earn more through arbitrage funds in higher tax brackets, but holding period, taxation and capital safety matter.
